# zoom


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

This notebook provides utilities for downloading Zoom meeting
transcripts:

- **Authentication**: Server-to-Server OAuth with Zoom API
- **List recordings**: Search recent meetings with recordings
- **Download transcripts**: Fetch VTT transcript files
- **Batch operations**: Download multiple transcripts in parallel

Key functions: -
[`get_zoom_token()`](https://hamelsmu.github.io/hamel/zoom.html#get_zoom_token):
Authenticate with Zoom using OAuth credentials -
[`list_recordings()`](https://hamelsmu.github.io/hamel/zoom.html#list_recordings):
List meetings with recordings from recent days -
[`download_transcript()`](https://hamelsmu.github.io/hamel/zoom.html#download_transcript):
Download transcript for a specific meeting -
[`make_filename()`](https://hamelsmu.github.io/hamel/zoom.html#make_filename):
Generate safe filenames for transcripts

## Authentication

Zoom’s Server-to-Server OAuth requires three credentials: -
`ZOOM_CLIENT_ID` - Your app’s client ID - `ZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET` - Your
app’s client secret - `ZOOM_ACCOUNT_ID` - Your Zoom account ID

Set these as environment variables or in a `.env` file.

### get_zoom_token

>  get_zoom_token ()

*Get Zoom access token using Server-to-Server OAuth.*

``` python
# Test authentication (requires env vars set)
_token = get_zoom_token()
assert isinstance(_token, str) and len(_token) > 0
```

## List Recordings

Search for meetings with recordings from the last N days. The API
returns paginated results, so we fetch all pages.

### list_recordings

>  list_recordings (days:int=45)

*List meetings with recordings from the last N days.*

``` python
# Test listing recordings
_meetings = list_recordings(days=45)
[m['topic'] for m in meetings][:2]
```

## Download Transcripts

Download the VTT transcript file for a specific meeting. Returns `None`
if no transcript is available.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a href="https://github.com/hamelsmu/hamel/blob/main/hamel/zoom.py#L71"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### download_transcript

>  download_transcript (meeting_id:str, token:str)

*Download transcript for a meeting ID.*

``` python
# Test downloading a transcript
transcript = download_transcript(str(_meetings[1]['id']), _token)
len(transcript), transcript[:10]
```

    (36933, 'WEBVTT\r\n\r\n')

modes: - Direct download by meeting ID - Search and select meetings
interactively - Batch download all matching meetings
